native.drift: Reanimated starts each withSequence step on the frame its predecessor finished, and a withTiming finishes on the first frame at or past its duration. On a steady display clock every step still lands on its toolbox frame (durations end 1 µs early to absorb float noise); a frame whose timestamp arrives early by more than that pushes the rest of that value's sequence one frame late, and the lag adds up step by step. Export with animation "worklet" for frame-exact playback whatever the clock does.
